Purpose: Summarize characteristics of included studies.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list=ls())

library(haven)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
```

To tabulate RCT data characteristics first

# Load data

```{r load_data, echo=FALSE}
datapath <- paste0(here(),"/data_sas/")

dat_rct_include<- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "study_kq1_rct_include.sas7bdat"))
dat_include <- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "study_kq1_include.sas7bdat"))
dat_inc_arm <- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "study_kq1_inc_arms.sas7bdat"))
```


# Table 1: Characteristics of included studies (including RCTs and non-RCTs)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
dat_include_1 <- left_join(dat_include, dat_inc_arm, by = join_by(Extraction_ID)) %>% 
  mutate(
    publication_yr_cat = case_when(
      Publication_Date <= 2005 ~ "<=2005",
      Publication_Date >= 2006 & Publication_Date <= 2010 ~ "2006-2010",
      Publication_Date >= 2011 & Publication_Date <= 2015 ~ "2011-2015",
      Publication_Date >= 2016 & Publication_Date <= 2020 ~ "2016-2020",
      Publication_Date >= 2021 ~ ">=2021"),
  samplesizes_n = as.numeric(design_tot_samplesize),
  ) %>%
    labelled::set_variable_labels(
    design_analysis = "Study designs",
    study_start_year = "Study start year",
    publication_yr_cat = "Years of Publication",
    samplesizes_n = "Sample Sizes",
    country_us = "United States",
    country_ca = "Canada",
    country_uk = "United Kingdom",
    country_fr = "France",
    country_ge = "Germany",
    country_jp = "Japan",
    country_china = "China",
    country_in = "India",
    country_ot = "Other",
    flag_funding_industry = "Industry",
    flag_funding_Nindustry = "Non-industry",
    flag_funding_NR = "Not reported",
    flag_funding_N = "Not funded",
    setting_inpatient = "Inpatient",
    setting_outpatient = "Outpatient",
    setting_nr = "Not reported",
    design_crit_journal_new = "Criteria: Journal publication",
    design_crit_ctgov_new = "Criteria: ClinicalTrials.gov",
    design_crit_csr_new = "Criteria: Clinical study report",
    design_how_harms_collect = "Collection of harms data",
    flag_sema = "Semaglutide",
    flag_lira = "Liraglutide",
    flag_tirz = "Tirzepatide",
    flag_orli = "Orlistat",
    flag_setm = "Setmelanotide",
    flag_phto = "Phentermine/topiramate",
    flag_nabu = "Naltrexone/bupropion"
    ) 

```

# Summarize sample size by study design type
```{r}
table(dat_include_1$design_analysis)
```

```{r}
samplesizes_summary <- dat_include_1 %>%
  mutate(
    design_group = case_when(
      design_analysis %in% c("RCT") ~ "RCT",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(design_group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_sample_size = mean(samplesizes_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sample_size = sd(samplesizes_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_sample_size = median(samplesizes_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_sample_size = min(samplesizes_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_sample_size = max(samplesizes_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_studies = n()
  )
```

```{r}
samplesizes_summary
```


# Output table
```{r, echo=FALSE}

table1 <- dat_include_1 %>% 
  select(design_analysis, publication_yr_cat, samplesizes_n, country_us, country_ca, country_uk, country_fr, 
         country_ge, country_jp, country_china, country_in, country_ot,
         flag_funding_industry, flag_funding_Nindustry, flag_funding_NR,
         flag_funding_N, setting_inpatient, setting_outpatient, setting_nr,
         design_how_harms_collect,
         design_crit_journal_new, design_crit_ctgov_new, design_crit_csr_new,
         flag_sema, flag_lira, flag_tirz, flag_orli, flag_setm, 
         flag_phto, flag_nabu) |>
  tbl_summary(missing = "no",
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = list(
                all_continuous() ~ c("{mean} ({sd})", "{p25}, {median}, {p75}", "{min}, {max}"),
                all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              digits = all_continuous() ~ 0,  
              ) |>
  modify_header(label = "**Study characteristics**") |>
  bold_labels()

table1
```
